conviction_note: Little here is unpriced. Since 21 July the company has said full-year operating profit will land near the low end of its ¥5.0-10.0bn range, and the IFIS consensus already sits there (OP ¥5,158m, revenue ¥52,665m, below the revenue floor). dip held a ¥12.0bn guide all through FY26 and then printed ¥9.1bn without revising, so a cut at this print is unlikely. The progressive dividend puts a floor under the ¥97 payout. The one input not on the wire is the 全求協 part-time listings series. It points to Q2 media revenue at the weak end of the company's own -3% to -11% fan, which is a public proxy and inside the guide, so it stays small. The name has fallen on 8 of its last 11 prints, which keeps p_up just under 50: abs 4.0 x (2 x 0.47 - 1) = -0.24, against an impact_sum of -0.10.

Full-year bar: IFIS consensus OP ¥5,158m / OI ¥5,012m / revenue ¥52,665m as of 2026-10-09 (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=2379), against the company range OP ¥5,000-10,000m / revenue ¥53,500-57,600m (Q1 短信, https://pdf.irpocket.com/C2379/xoA3/SFxs/EYLI/PpKu.pdf). There is no post-Q1 Q2 consensus, so the quarter-level bar is the company's fan and the sizes on it are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 2.11 on 2026-10-02 (margin longs 232.1k shares vs shorts 110.1k), up from 2.02 a week earlier: kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=2379. Margin longs are about one day of volume (20d median turnover ¥378m, about 215k shares a day). The longs are not crowded and there is no short to squeeze. The stock has held ¥1,750-1,870 since the Q1 print and sits on a 5.5% dividend yield and at the consensus target price of ¥1,754.

findings.finding: The forecast decision is already pre-released and the bar sits at its floor. On 2026-07-21 the company told analysts to expect FY OP 'closer to the lower end than the midpoint' of ¥5.0-10.0bn. IFIS consensus has moved to OP ¥5,158m and revenue ¥52,665m, below the ¥53,500m revenue floor. dip held its FY26 OP guide of ¥12.0bn unchanged at Q2 and Q3 and then delivered ¥9.1bn without filing a 修正, so holding the range (or narrowing it to the low end) is the likely outcome, and that is a relief rather than a disappointment against this bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The only separate 修正 in four years (2024-01-11, FY24 Q3) took the stock -21.6% the next session. The new-year guide on 2026-04-14 (range OP ¥5-10bn against ¥9.1bn the year before) took it -9.4%. The held guide at Q2 FY26 (2025-10-14) took it -2.7%. Moves from Yahoo daily bars, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2379.T?range=3y&interval=1d.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The low-end steer has been public for twelve weeks, consensus and the target price (¥1,754) have converged on it, and the stock is flat since. What is left is the asymmetry: a held or low-end-narrowed range against a consensus already at the floor removes the cut risk. If the market feared a cut below ¥5bn, the stock would trade below its yield floor or the margin longs would be unwinding, and neither shows.
findings.independence: The no-revision habit comes from a different document, the FY26 Q2 短信, which carries 'no revision' on the ¥12.0bn guide (https://pdf.irpocket.com/C2379/w4ok/LwO1/ggcY.pdf, 2025-10-14), set against the FY26 actual of ¥9,112m (https://pdf.irpocket.com/C2379/nX8G/pHS8/SM0m.pdf, 2026-04-14). The consensus level comes from IFIS via kabuyoho, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=2379.

findings.finding: The independent industry series puts Q2 at the weak end of the company's own fan. 全求協 part-time/arbeit listings (weekly average, member media) ran -12.9% / -12.8% / -11.5% YoY in Jun/Jul/Aug 2026, against -15.5% / -15.9% / -14.5% in Mar-May. That is about 3pp better, but dip's media revenue has run about 2pp above this series (Q1 -13.5% vs -15.3%), which implies Q2 media revenue near -10% YoY, the bottom of the company's -3% to -11% outlook. With Q2's seasonal step down from Q1 and a full quarter of the ad push that began in May, Q2 OP looks likely to fall well short of last year's ¥2,064m, and H1 progress against even the ¥5.0bn floor looks likely to be far below the company's own 49-60% H1 share in FY24-FY26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 (OP -75.8%, 16% progress against the low end, 64% under the IFIS OI consensus) moved only -2.1% the next session (2026-07-13) and -3.4% over two. Q3 FY26 moved -2.9%. A visible miss on this name has cost about 2-3%, not more.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The weak quarter is computable from the Q1 短信 and the company's own fan, and the 全求協 file is public. If the market had fully read it, the consensus would have fallen below the guidance floor on OP as it already has on revenue. It has not (OP ¥5,158m). Sized small because the read stays inside the company's own guided fan, and a known bad number on a 5.5% yielder can land as 悪材料出尽くし.
findings.independence: The company's own fan and its statement that growth was improving from June are in the Q1 presentation p.4 (https://pdf.irpocket.com/C2379/xoA3/SFxs/EYLI/os2k.pdf), which is consistent with a ~3pp improvement. The SG&A seasonality (Q1→Q2 down ¥1.3-1.6bn in FY25 and FY26) comes from the same presentation's P&L appendix. One document family, so it counts once.

findings.finding: Shareholder returns put a floor under the payout and give a small optional upside. The policy is a progressive dividend (the prior year's dividend is the floor), so the ¥97 plan (¥48 interim) survives any profit cut. The mid-term cash-allocation slide also says that if mid-term profit targets look hard to reach, the company will consider additional returns 'to approach the ROE target'. A buyback at H1 is low probability, because cash of about ¥16bn sits below the stated maximum cash of about ¥17bn, but it is not zero. The last buybacks were announced on 2023-04-26, 2024-01-25 and 2024-06-03, none of them with an H1 print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No capital-return surprise has landed with a print in the last three years. The 2024-01-25 buyback came two weeks after the -21.6% revision day.
findings.why_not_priced: The dividend floor is public policy and is priced: it is why the stock holds a 5.5% yield. The buyback option is not priced at all, and the reason is that the cash test argues against it. If the market expected one, the stock would have run up into the print rather than drifting -2% over 20 days.
findings.independence: The buyback dates come from the irpocket release archive (https://xml.irpocket.com/2379/JS/release-all-12m-202401.js) and the dividend plan from the Q1 短信 (https://pdf.irpocket.com/C2379/xoA3/SFxs/EYLI/PpKu.pdf). Both are company documents.

outside_window.finding: The CPC (pay-per-click) model built with Geniee is to launch 'within the fiscal year' and the company flags a temporary revenue dip. The guidance bridge carries a CPC hit of ¥0.5-4.5bn, so its timing decides where in the range FY OP lands, but it resolves in H2.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely. dip held a guide it missed by 24% all of FY26, consensus already sits at the ¥5bn floor, and the company has pre-steered to the low end. A narrowing to the low end would be in line, and a cut below ¥5bn is the tail risk. Returns: dividend held at ¥97 under the progressive policy, buyback low probability. New-year guide: not applicable at H1. Quarter vs own 進捗率: H1 OP likely about 20-35% of the ¥5bn floor against 49-60% H1 shares in FY24-26, but that is computable from the Q1 短信 and so is mostly priced.

baseline_tension: This agrees with the flat run-up and the near-zero priced lean: nothing found cuts hard against the price. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held range plus an unexpected buyback under the mid-term 'additional returns' clause. I looked and found the cash test arguing against it, so it is filed small. A held range against a consensus already at the floor is the base case, and it is a relief.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series or a 進捗率 computable from the last 短信): the reported-quarter finding went from -0.8 to -0.5, and p_up from 45 to 47, because the release is unlikely to add a forecast or dividend cut on this company's own record.
Rule 2 (check the sign): wrote the strongest positive (held range, buyback option) into baseline_tension. I had already looked for it, so no further change.
